errors.text: The proposed 2–5 GPa and 700–800 °C anneal does not reconstruct the required 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT window.
Adding severe plastic deformation makes the treatment fundamentally different from the hexahedron-anvil HPHT intervention.
The HIP comparison does not isolate pressure because the groups also differ in prior deformation, temperature, and thermal history.
The alloy is repeatedly identified as AlCoCrFeNi2.1 rather than the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi composition.
The cited evidence does not directly establish that the proposed SPD plus pressure anneal produces coherent patterned interfaces in this alloy.
